evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:OrderRepository.init_schema creates only one table and minisvc/storage/repo.py:OrderRepository.save uses a plain sqlite INSERT on a fresh connection each call; minisvc/config.py:load_settings defaults DB path to relative orders.sqlite.
impact: Data can land in an unexpected file and the service has no explicit durability or migration policy beyond the basic SQLite default.
mitigation: Set an explicit absolute MINISVC_DB in each environment, add migration/versioning, and define backup and SQLite pragma policy.

impact: Order create/read actions are not durably recorded, which weakens traceability and incident review.
mitigation: Add an audit schema plus persistence path, then call it from create/read flows.
